blocks.text: CEBU PROVINCE, Philippines—Action in the Governor’s Cup Under-18 Basketball Tournament is heating up, and so is the race for the top individual honors. At the end of the elimination round, five players found themselves in a tight race for Most Valuable Player (MVP). Rjay Wagas leads the race with 56.2 statistical points (SPs), thanks to averages of 13.6 points, 14.2 rebounds, 6.2 assists, 2.4 steals, and 4.2 blocks per game.
